scope: Early budget slice only; frozen176b192; no whole W12/C13/C14 acceptance
independence: Existing domain setup helpers only create project/goal/run. Independently authored budget requests are sent through httptest.NewServer over loopback HTTP, and durable SQLite rows captured. Product/spec/ledger untouched. No external model/provider calls.

findings.title: UNKNOWN observation can alias the original reservation and bypass final settlement/cap
findings.trigger: Under parent cap10, RESERVE6 R -> UNKNOWN U(reservation_id=R) -> COMMIT6(reservation_id=R) -> COMMIT0(reservation_id=U) -> new RESERVE10. All five POSTs return201.
findings.expected: A second COMMIT for one provider request is rejected or governed by explicit reconciliation semantics; prior actual6 remains counted and another10 exceeds cap10.
findings.actual: Terminal lookup only checks supplied reservation_id. U is accepted as another reservation because it is UNKNOWN. Exposure groups by provider request and takes the newest money, replacing spent6 with0; new10 is admitted.
findings.impact: Authorized but malformed/replayed accounting chain can permit cap exposure16 against10 and erase known spent from admission calculations.
findings.recommendation: Bind every liability observation and settlement to one immutable canonical admission/provider request, enforce terminal state for that whole chain, and prevent UNKNOWN aliases from reopening COMMIT. Keep legitimate later invoices as explicit reconciliation.

findings.title: Late actual billing correction after COMMIT cannot be appended
findings.trigger: RESERVE8 R -> COMMIT6(R) -> new provider_event RECONCILE7(R).
findings.expected: Append the late actual bill/reconciliation without overwriting earlier immutable observations and account the corrected amount against the same original Run.
findings.actual: RECONCILE returns409 STATE_CONFLICT request already settled; SQLite retains only RESERVE8 and COMMIT6.
findings.impact: New provider invoice corrections are lost from authoritative ledger; original Run cannot be fully reconciled once any COMMIT/RECONCILE/RELEASE exists.
findings.spec_basis: 07_OPERATIONS_AND_EVOLUTION.md section5.1: late actual bills append reconciliation events and do not overwrite observations; C14-03 late settlements remain recorded.
findings.recommendation: Differentiate admission/settlement closure from immutable subsequent reconciliation. Accept idempotent new-event invoice corrections on the canonical request while rejecting a duplicate COMMIT.

verified_boundaries: Arbitrary-precision decimal at >37 fractional digits; exact boundary accepted, epsilon excess blocked.
